choices.name: Teragard's Aegis
effects: Base ability damage gains 25% of total armour value, doubled with a defender and tripled with a shield.
Base health regeneration gains 2.5% of maximum life points with the same multipliers.

assumptions: "Total armour value" is read as the player's total Armour stat from the Loadout screen, which the wiki Armour page derives from equipment tier and slot alone. Level-derived armour, prayer and curse block levels, and Fortitude's x1.15 belong to the hit-chance armour rating and are excluded.
The shield and defender shares are the card's flat 25/50/75%, so the percentage resolves before the single rounding: floor(armour x 0.75), not floor(armour x 0.25) x 3.
Only a genuinely wielded off-hand qualifies; a stored shield or defender under a two-handed weapon does not, and a shield effect granted by an ability is not a wielded shield.
The armour contribution is added to base ability damage before the ability's own damage band.

choices.name: Big Boned
effects: Maximum life points +50%.
Damage dealt gains bonus damage equal to 5% of maximum life points.

assumptions: The wiki card reads "all damage you deal gains 5% of your maximum life points as bonus damage", so the bonus is an attached, non-critical component on every qualifying damage instance rather than once per cast.
Maximum life points is the current maximum after temporary boosts, so Fortitude, bonfires, thermal baths and a Powerburst of vitality all raise the bonus.
Autonomous conjure damage, equipment and perk procs, attached components and blessing-generated damage do not carry the bonus.

choices.name: Adrenaline Junkie
effects: Maximum adrenaline +50%.
Adrenaline generation +50%.

assumptions: The generation multiplier applies to listed ability adrenaline gains only. Impatient's flat +3, the Jaws of the Abyss bleed grant, Vestments' ultimate refund and a Relentless refund are separate grants and are not multiplied.

reason: Record the audited tier-one mechanics: the Aegis armour basis is the Loadout screen's total Armour stat rather than the block armour rating, only a wielded off-hand multiplies it, Big Boned follows the card's "all damage you deal" wording, and Adrenaline Junkie multiplies listed generation only.

choices.name: Striking Light
effects: Basic attack damage +40%.
Basic attacks trigger Light of Saradomin on a 9-second cooldown for 40-60% ability damage plus 250% of armour value.

assumptions: The March 2026 Combat Style Modernisation removed auto-attacks and replaced them with basic attacks, which are ordinary Basic-category abilities. "Basic attack" is therefore read as the whole Basic category, which is the broader of the two readings: the narrower one would restrict the bonus to the four replacement basic attacks alone. Untested.
Light triggers from the first landed direct hit while off cooldown, is a separate critical-eligible hit with its own cap, and takes 250% of the same total Armour stat Teragard's Aegis reads.
A multi-hit basic triggers Light once: the 9-second cooldown outlives the cast.

choices.name: Barkscales
effects: Incoming damage is reduced by 10% of armour value.
After five reductions, triggers Grasp of Guthix for 80-120% ability damage as poison in a 3x3 area.

assumptions: The trigger rate needs an incoming qualifying-hit interval, which an outgoing rotation cannot supply; without one the blessing reports no calculated damage rather than zero.
The reduction takes 10% of the total Armour stat, and the five-hit counter is read as resetting to zero on each trigger.
Grasp is poison damage, so it is not critical-eligible, deals nothing to a poison-immune target, and cannot generate further blessing damage.
Each occupied tile of the 3x3 is counted as one Grasp application.

choices.name: Abyssal Cinders
effects: Attacks deal 15% of ability damage as bonus damage.
5% on-hit chance to trigger Inferno of Zamorak for 100-200% ability damage to one target.

assumptions: The wiki card prefixes both clauses with "On hit", so the 5% Inferno roll happens once per qualifying landed hit rather than once per cast: seven-hit Greater Ricochet expects 0.35 applications, eight-hit Rapid Fire 0.40.
The 15% component is attached and non-critical, and also rides damage-over-time ticks; a damage-over-time tick does not roll Inferno, being the tail of an attack whose landing already rolled.
Inferno is a non-recursive critical-eligible expected-value event; its maximum represents every roll landing.

reason: Correct Inferno of Zamorak to the card's per-landed-hit wording, give Barkscales real parameters plus a scenario-dependent support status instead of an empty record, and pin Striking Light's armour basis to the same total Armour stat.

choices.name: Sacred Fervor
effects: Ability and special-attack cooldowns are reduced by 30% for all four combat styles.

excluded: Weapon special-attack cooldowns, which the engine does not model as their own clocks
Dynamic cooldowns not represented by an ability record
assumptions: Cooldown creation uses floor(default ticks x 0.7), so shared cooldown groups and replacement groups inherit the reduction from the clock they start; cast occupancy and the global cooldown do not change.
Death Skulls' Living Death cooldown is reduced after its own dynamic value resolves.

choices.name: Splash Zone
effects: AoE and multi-target attacks deal 30% more damage.
AoE abilities deal 5% more damage per tile occupied by the target.

assumptions: Only explicitly tagged AoE and multi-target attacks qualify; the two bonuses are additive with each other.
The per-tile bonus applies to AoE only and counts every declared occupied tile, so a single-tile target grants one step of 5%. No cap is assumed because none is stated.
Blessing-generated damage is excluded, so the amplification cannot compound on itself.

choices.name: Demon's Mark
effects: Accuracy is always calculated using the target's weakness.

assumptions: An explicitly declared applicable weakness selects the most favorable affinity; a target with no declared weakness is unaffected.
A manual Damage Potential override remains authoritative, and the affinity is never made worse than the target's own.

reason: Sacred Fervor cannot claim full support while weapon special-attack and charge cooldowns are unmodelled; shared and replacement groups are handled and no longer belong in the excluded list.

choices.name: Steadfast Will
effects: Bash deals additional damage equal to 350-450% of armour value.
Preparation reduces all ability cooldowns by 12 seconds.
Reflect returns 100% of incoming damage plus 10-15% of armour value, and affects 8 additional targets.
Revenge duration and cooldown are doubled, and its maximum stacks rise to 20.

assumptions: The four empowered abilities are displayed with their sourced values but excluded from calculated totals: Reflect and Revenge need incoming-attack simulation, and Bash and Preparation are not represented as ability records the engine can reach.

choices.name: Eternal Sustenance
effects: Food is not consumed when eaten.
Eating no longer drains adrenaline.

assumptions: Neither effect changes outgoing damage, and the simulator does not model eating, so both are displayed and excluded rather than estimated.

choices.name: Avernic Rampage
effects: 5% on-attack chance to activate a 7.2-second window where abilities and weapon special attacks, other than the granite maul's, cost 0% adrenaline.

excluded: The granite maul special-attack exception, which has no ability record to exclude
assumptions: "On-attack" is read as one roll per cast that lands at least one hit, never one per hit.
The triggering cast pays its normal cost; a proc opens or refreshes a 12-tick half-open free-cast window.
The window is probability-weighted branching rather than an averaged discount, because it changes which later casts are affordable.

reason: Record the wiki's sourced Steadfast Will values so the card shows real numbers while staying excluded from totals, and note Avernic Rampage's granite maul exception and per-cast roll.
